te MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY, DIVISION OF PURCHASING, AND THE SPORTS AUTHORITY -OF THE METROPOLITAN GOVERNMENT OF NASHVILLE AND DAVIDSON COUNTY This Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) is entered into this 4 oor 2002, between the of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County (“Metropolitan Government,”) by and through its Division of Purchasing, (“Purchasing”) and the Sports Authority of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County (‘Sports Authority.”) WITNESSETH WHEREAS, the Sports Authority is authorized, pursuant to Tennessee Code Annotated §7-67-109, to enter into contracts for the purposes for which the Sports Authority was created; and WHEREAS, the Sports Authority wishes to have assistance in acquiring goods and services to maintain and operate its sport facilities; and WHEREAS, Purchasing has procedures in place to acquire goods and services of this nature; NOW, THEREFORE, for the mutual promises set forth herein, the parties agree as follows:
1. In those instances where the Sports Authority is responsible for purchases of goods and services to maintain and operate its sport facilities, it shall follow the Metropolitan Government’s Procurement Code (“Procurement Code”) and use the services of Purchasing to handle the acquisition.
2. In compliance with the Procurement Code, Purchasing shall handle the acquisition of goods and services in those instances where the Sports Authority is responsible for maintaining and operating its sport facilities.
3. Notices to the Purchasing shall be sent to: Purchasing Agent Metropolitan Government Division of Purchasing 222 Second Avenue, North Nashville, TN 37201
4. Notices to the Sports Authority shall be sent to: Director Sports Authority of Metropolitan Government 222 Second Avenue, North Nashville, TN 37201
5. This Memorandum comprises the entire agreement of the parties. The Memorandum may be modified only by a written agreement executed by authorized representatives of both parties. RECEIVED JAN 14 2003 METROPOLITAN CLERK Final.dac/7/1 1/02 10:14 Apitde
6. This Memorandum shall be in effect for a period of one year. It may be renewed with the consent of both parties for up to four terms of one year each. APPROVED: 9 Stephen B.
